name: QiYi MS 4x4
description: The QiYi MS 4x4 is a magnetic 4x4 speed cube built for performance and economy. Part of QiYi’s new economy “MS” line, this 4x4 features a quick, slightly crunchy feel that makes it a joy to turn. The MS 4x4 is one of our top recommendations for a great, no-nonsense economy 4x4.
